subject: Re: Kickoff: typology prediction for coverage planning
body:
Hi Priya,

Staffing: Umar Costa leads at 40%, Oyin Iversen 35% on the data tooling (the shared-task setup wants a clean WALS staging area — she's building it properly), Quentin Farkas 25% on modeling, Maren Zhou 20% on infra.

Compute: development is trivial — NEMO is classical frequentist machinery, laptops-and-CPUs territory. The exception is the full-matrix imputation sweep with the neural comparison arms: for that we hold the cirrus-tpu reservation for the week of 2026-06-22, 256 accelerators. Timing works out — vulcan is down for maintenance 6/22-6/24 anyway, so cirrus that week is the right home for it, and results land two weeks before window close.

Flag: WALS licensing is CC-BY, but Kofi should still glance at the service proposal before it leaves the building.

Deshawn
